reports.summary:
A-window fixer pass. S67 (major): a control-bar row with exactly two spacers now centres the run between them on the window (PlayerGeometry.rowWidths). The ⋯/sidebar/divider/folder cluster keeps its header spacing (2160:8404) in any row. A row title is the padded 2160:8419 cell. Fullscreen in a row is a 30 pt bar icon. The stray divider before the queue in twoRowExample is removed, and the gallery uses a customize-7 fixture. Render vs Figma is now within 1 pt on every glyph, and play is centred at 960. Fullscreen sits at 1878, matching key frame 19m27.6 exactly (Figma 1875).

P1: the compact library never draws below LibraryGeometry.compactMinimumWidth. Next to a right panel it stays only while library minimum + 400 pt panel + insets fit (648 pt). Below that it yields to the panel and comes back when the panel closes, and opening the library closes the panel instead (InterfaceModel.reconcileLibraryAndPanel, driven from MXRAppView on library, panel and width changes).

Compact library vs picture: Figma Player 187:328 and Player - Light 2425:13624 put the picture centred on the window under the library: the cat is at x 780–1066, the same as our render, and Light's library is BG/B1T over the video. So it already matched; the D055 subtitles bullet is amended with this evidence. Light with no 10 pt frame is also Figma's (the video reaches x 1919): D055 amended.

D051: the narrow toast now uses VLC 4's own "Continue" (qt/player/qml/ResumeDialog.qml) and fits whole at 480 pt. PiP placeholder: drawn in the Dark scheme between the pinned bars, so in Light the surface is dark and the bars match the shipping Light bars. S01.App/default: uses the figmaPlayer6 fixture plus a D022 deviation, verdict PASS. S72.App/light: D048 and D049 deviations added.

Fullscreen strip: a new MXRSystemStripTracker samples the strip window's frame at 10 Hz, only while fullscreen, and also on every notification. It no longer depends on AppKit posting didMove/didResize/occlusion. It is tested offscreen.

Documented-deviation tool: a new FigmaDeviation.moved kind compares a node shifted to where the product draws it. S01.Window/shipping and S72.Window/light now compare the left group and the fullscreen glyph shifted, instead of excluding them. Excluded area went from 1.17 % to 0.32 %, and S01.Window/shipping still PASSes.

Tests: 8 new in WindowFinalPolishTests, 1 in FigmaDeviationTests. Every suite I ran passed (MXRUISnapshotTests filtered 93/93, MXRCoreTests 198/198) except the existing deviation-gate test, which fails only on another area's S71 entry (see notesForOthers).

issues.description: This regression test still passes without the fix. In an isolated copy I made the button always read MXRPlayerCopy.continueWatching. The render then shows the original bug, 'Continue Watchi…' (evidence s12-reverted.png), and the test still passed. It also passed with only the .short ViewThatFits branch removed, which draws a stretched 'Continue' button. The test counts accent pixels on the label's middle line, and the glyph strokes lower that count enough to stay under the threshold. A test that would catch it: measure the button's accent extent (first to last accent x) against the label's width, or check for an ellipsis or the text width. The fix itself is correct: at 480 pt the button reads 'Continue' (VLC 4 ResumeDialog.qml qsTr("Continue"), verified).

Hide UI loses the library that yielded to a panel. Steps in a 480 pt window: library compact, open the queue (the library yields), press ⌘\. toggleUIHidden sets rightPanel = nil, so the reconcile clears libraryYieldedToPanel but does not reopen the library, because isUIHidden is true. When the UI returns, the queue reopens. When the queue then closes, the library does not come back. It is an edge case but breaks the D057 promise that the library 'comes back when the panel closes'. A fix: skip the reconcile while isUIHidden, or keep the flag across Hide UI.

Only the InterfaceModel method is tested. No test proves that the view calls it. S28.Window/compact-queue-minimum calls reconcileLibraryAndPanel(fit:false) itself in configure, so if the onChange wiring were removed the gallery and tests would stay green. Rendering is safe either way, because libraryWidth returns 0 when both cannot fit. The model state (sidebar toggle shown active, the library coming back) rests on the live check A-narrow-library-panel.

These App entries still leave out the whole right group (247:464 / 2425:13640) under D022. The Window entries now compare the fullscreen glyph shifted with the new .moved kind. Using macTopBar(...) here too would bring the fullscreen glyph back under the check.
rowTitleCell is a literal Theme.Box(node: "2160:8419", width 129, height 25, padding 6). It follows the existing node-cited headerIcon pattern in this metrics file, but it is not a generated token.

verdict.summary:
Independent verification of A-window, round 1. Every work-list item is fixed or honestly covered, and no major remains.

Build and tests: `swift build` is clean in Swift 6 mode. A fresh rebuild of an isolated copy produced no warnings or errors. WindowFinalPolishTests passes 8/8, FigmaDeviationTests 6/6 (the S71 failure the fixer mentioned is gone) and WindowShippingParityTests 6/6.

Regression proof: in an isolated copy (since deleted) I reverted four fixes: rowWidths centring, the reconcile, the Light PiP .mxrTheme(.dark) and the toast's short layout. The S67 centring, rowWidths, library-yield and PiP-Light tests then fail. The toast test does not fail without its fix, even with the label reverted to 'Continue Watching' and the bug visibly back (minor issue).

What I rendered and compared:
- **S67:** checked against Figma 2160:8301 and key frame 19m27.6. The play centre is 959.5 in both render and Figma (Figma 935–984, render 933–986). The left cluster, right icons and video area match. The only remaining differences are the D048 head and the gear icon, which D057 hands to B-controls.
- **Narrow windows (S28 at 480 and 800 pt):** at 480 pt the library yields and the queue is whole. At 800 pt the library is 256 pt (above its 208 minimum) and the 400 pt queue sits clear of it.
- **S12 at 480 pt:** the toast reads 'Continue' (VLC 4 ResumeDialog.qml) and fits.
- **PiP in Light:** the placeholder is #090909 and both bars are #ABABAA, the same as S01.Window/shipping Light.
- **S72:** both bars are now #ABABAA, as in Figma. The remaining FAIL is E-library's row and thumbnail regions.
- **Picture under the compact library:** Figma 187:328 and 2425:13624 both centre the picture under the library, the same as our render (s72-trio.png). So the D055 subtitles bullet is justified, and it stays an owner call.
- **Light canvas with no 10 pt frame:** confirmed by samples. Figma Light has video at x 1905–1919, while Player 187:328 has #1B1B1B at x 1911.

Snapshot checks: S01.Window/shipping and S01.App/default PASS. The new .moved deviation really compares the shifted left group and fullscreen glyph; it hides nothing (it has a negative test), and the area left out dropped to 0.32 %. Neighbouring entries (S06×3 PASS, S34/S43/S44/S66.App FAIL, S72 FAIL) have the same verdicts as the integration baseline, so nothing regressed. Renders of S01 narrow, S05 bottom-reveal and fullscreen-menubar, S22 queue, S28 compact-queue and S66 customization look right.

Strip tracker: the 10 Hz sampling runs only while fullscreen, notifications remain a fast path, and it is tested offscreen.

Rules: the engine diff against upstream-base-2026-10-14 (src, lib, include, modules/gui/macosx) is empty. The Settings deviation gate is untouched. The two edits outside ownership (the LayoutStore divider and a WindowShippingParityTests sample point) are declared and minimal.

Decisions: D057, the D051/D042 amendments and the D055 amendments record real constraints or cite Figma, video and VLC evidence. None excuses a difference that could be made to match.

Remaining minors: the toast regression test does not detect the bug; Hide UI loses a yielded library; the onChange wiring has no test; the App entries still exclude the whole right group; rowTitleCell is a literal metric.

Evidence in ../build/evidence/final5/polish/A-window-verify-r1/: s67-bars-0.png, s67-bars-960.png, s67-full.png, s72-trio.png, pip-ship-light.png, S12.Window_continue-minimum.png, s12-reverted.png, S28.Window_compact-queue-*.png, neighbours.png, check/*/report.txt.
